verification_scope: Code and data release validation; not a fresh execution of the full benchmark or an independent scientific replication.

plan_validation.command: conda run -n ml python run.py plan

reference_validation.command: conda run -n ml python run.py check-results

source_preservation.comparison_baseline: The research artifact supplied by the authors for this public release.
source_preservation.comparison_method: Direct byte comparison; no exhaustive cryptographic manifest.
release_changes: MIT code license and citation metadata
Dataset attribution and retained upstream license notice
Eight tabular input files added without value or row-order changes

tabular_data_validation.command: conda run -n ml python tools/prepare_tabular_data.py --from-local legacy/Datasets
additional_checks: Byte equality with provided local data
Expected row counts and ordered schemas

diamonds_provenance_check.comparison: 53,940 rows; exact numeric and categorical value equality, with identical column order and row order. No deduplication.

packaging.command: conda run -n ml python -m pip wheel --no-deps --no-build-isolation --wheel-dir <temporary-output> .
packaging.distribution_scope: Git repository for full code, data and launcher; wheel validates the two source packages and console-entry-point metadata.

publication_checks.configured_secret_value_scan: No matches in Git-included candidate files; values are never recorded.
publication_checks.cache_schemas: No raw text or provider request/response identifiers; array loading uses allow_pickle=False.
publication_checks.scope_note: Signature and schema checks cannot prove absence of all possible secret formats. Runtime logs, caches, build directories, and environment files are excluded.

independent_review.scope: Independent static review of source preservation, supported quickstart, data inclusion, licensing notices, private metadata and release claims, followed by a check of the generated verification JSON and standalone HTML.
independent_review.summary: No material publishing blockers found; all protected scientific files match the supplied artifact, all eight datasets are included, and plan/reference validators pass.

execution_notes: All recorded check commands completed successfully.
Restricted macOS CPU-capability probes produced nonfatal PyArrow warnings during data/reference checks.
The wheel build reported an unwritable pip cache and continued without using that cache.
No research design was retuned; only release checks and the existing tests were run. The tests include small mathematical/neural regression checks.
No fresh model rollout, LLM label, encoder feature, model-weight download, GPU run or complete benchmark execution was performed.
scientific_limits: The supplied new coverage selectors do not consistently outperform fixed unit PPI; adverse and null results remain included.
Random splits overlap. Paired bootstrap intervals are unadjusted and describe split variation, not independent population sampling.
Diamonds retains 146 exact duplicate full records and 345 duplicate X rows; row separation is not entity independence.
HelpSteer responses are clustered by prompt. Prompt separation of outer roles does not establish row-iid conformal validity.
Historical HelpSteer neural fits and the recorded CPU reconstruction are not numerically identical.
Civil Comments is historical source only; its input and label caches are not part of this release.
Historical generation/report scripts may require their original full-text layout and optional dependencies. run.py is the supported supplied-cache entry point.

handoff.study_identity: How Synthetic Labels Improve Conformal Prediction: A Perspective on Conditional Coverage
handoff.frozen_claim: The provided scientific implementation, designs, reference results and cached numerical inputs are preserved in the public release.
handoff.outcome_access: Only bundled numerical reference outcomes and release-check outputs were inspected. No new research outcome was generated.
handoff.next_authorized_step: Publish the reviewed code and data as a new public GitHub repository.
